description: Keep an eye on every Claude Code session from one floating tray panel.
pre_uninstall: # Perch holds its own files open while the tray is running, so stop this Scoop copy (and only this
# one - never a separately installed Perch) before Scoop replaces or removes the directory.
# On a real uninstall (never on an update, where the new version re-wires them on next launch) drop
# the things Perch registered outside this directory: the Claude Code hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json,
# the login registration, and any PATH entry.
notes: Perch lives in the system tray - launch it from the Start Menu shortcut or by running 'perch'.
Updates are Scoop's job here: run 'scoop update perch' (Perch will tell you when one is out).
Perch wires its own Claude Code hooks on first launch; 'scoop uninstall perch' removes them again.
